requirement: Publishing is fail-closed for an unresolved competition-related refund exception of the round, a stale input hash, an unresolved over-capacity callback tie and an ineligible roster; holds are limited to the affected round; there is no ordinary manager override of these safeguards.
enforcement_point: Database function (manager only); publication rows have no client write grants.
interpretation_notes: Inspected: signature has no override parameter; five refusals (stale hash, undecided tie, advancement mismatch, round-scoped refund exception, roster eligibility); wrong shape fails closed, deadlocks propagate. Separate, owner-approved D3 behavior: the calculator may approve their own result with a recorded reason (not one of the five holds; the stale-hash check runs first). OD-14 over-capacity tie policy: see the OD register. DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy, never a governing-body requirement. Verified here by SQL inspection and static pins only; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING an isolated Postgres under the heavy-lock queue).
decision_refs: R-12 (owner ratification 2026-11-24: DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy; implementation verified only when the release candidate passes review and testing)
